rows.behavior: The save-to-openviking skill loads (front matter), reads .map.md before saving, asks when no place was given and saves nothing before the answer, appends a new root to the map, falls back to exactly one list of the resources root, seeds the four roots, writes the map only with viking_write, and holds no hardcoded leaf folders beyond the seed.
rows.fails_when: any of those instructions is missing or contradicted in the skill.

rows.behavior: SOUL.md points at the save-to-openviking skill for any save and lists viking_write in its tool table, and still forbids shelling out to curl.
rows.fails_when: SOUL.md lacks the pointer or the viking_write row, or drops the curl rule.

rows.behavior: The openviking_tools wrapper exposes viking_write with create, replace and append; a call posts content/write with uri, content and mode; a bad mode or missing uri errors without a request; the upstream six still pass through.
rows.fails_when: viking_write is missing from the schemas, sends a different request, sends on bad input, or an upstream tool stops passing through.
rows.command: uv run --directory cli pytest tests/test_hermes_openviking_tools.py -k viking_write -q

rows.behavior: viking_add_resource with a parent reaches OpenViking with create_parent: true; without a parent it does not.
rows.fails_when: a parent-bearing call lacks create_parent: true, or a call without parent carries it.
rows.command: uv run --directory cli pytest tests/test_hermes_openviking_tools.py -k create_parent -q

rows.behavior: The image bakes faster-whisper 1.2.1 pinned to Hermes's uv.lock, config pins stt.provider local and stt.local.model base, and hermes_version is 0.22.2-3.
rows.fails_when: the Dockerfile line is missing or unpinned, either stt key differs, or the version pin is not 0.22.2-3.

rows.behavior: Live after deploy on Telegram: 'save this <url>' with no place makes Hermes read the map, propose a folder and ask before writing; 'save this to <folder>' writes there without asking; a voice note plus 'save the transcript' lands as a Markdown file in the confirmed folder; a new root the operator names appears in .map.md with its description.
rows.fails_when: the recorded post-deploy evidence shows any of these failing.
